issues.issue: The Statement of Activities (p2) shows only 129,852 as general-revenue Miscellaneous. The other 126,912 appears as Culture and recreation operating grants and contributions, so it probably comes from the Park and Recreation fund's 238,298 Miscellaneous (detail Park & Rec Miscellaneous, p15). That is about 49% of the line, just under the more-than-half rule, so other is defensible, but part of it is probably donations or grants.
